offense_strengths: Dart's running produced a 22-yard gain plus a personal foul, another scramble out of bounds, and a later run behind Likely.
Likely caught two touchdowns and multiple third-down passes, including the third-and-ten conversion across midfield.
Motion and deception contributed to Likely's second touchdown; Ricard and Likely supplied blocking on Skattebo's touchdown.
Repeated swing passes to Singletary produced a third-and-nine conversion and a nine-yard touchdown.
Skattebo broke a Caleb Downs tackle for a first down.
defense_weaknesses: Lamb created separation for a one-yard touchdown in a one-on-one matchup.
Reese was explicitly identified as fooled on Williams's 17-yard receiving touchdown.
Dallas completed a late third-and-ten sideline pass against a five-man rush.
Commentary connected Dallas's late offensive improvement with injuries and backup cornerbacks entering the Giants secondary.

offense_strengths: Prescott converted first downs with a scramble and sideline completions to Pickens and an unidentified late-game receiver.
Lamb supplied a goal-line touchdown and a third-down catch on which he escaped a safety.
Williams scored both behind blockers at right tackle and on a 17-yard reception.
defense_weaknesses: Dart's 22-yard keeper was compounded by Overshown's unnecessary-roughness penalty.
Commentary identified a coverage breakdown on Likely's 15-yard touchdown, with two defenders following a shallow receiver and the end-zone corner left open.
Dallas repeatedly allowed Singletary swing passes, including a broken tackle against Thompson on third and nine and a subsequent touchdown.
A five-man rush did not prevent Dart's third-and-ten completion to Likely.
Downs missed a tackle on Skattebo's first-down run, and a late facemask extended a Giants possession.

limitations: Captions only; no frames were viewed. Fragmentary snaps are included with uncertain results explicitly marked. Supplied DB entries are selective, so NO DB MATCH does not mean a play did not occur. No caption evidence identifies the supplied kick returns or 38-yard pass-interference play. Yards are null unless established by a clear DB match or explicit caption field positions. The interception's zero yards denotes return yardage; Tracy's eight yards denotes the run before his fumble. Named tacklers in defender_beaten are not necessarily defenders who lost their matchup. Personnel and coverage details are limited to explicit commentary; DB shotgun labels alone were not used. The hit involving the receiver transcribed as Runyan cannot safely be merged with Tracy's separately referenced fumble. Unclear receiver names were left unresolved, and speculative pick-route commentary was not treated as a confirmed concept.
